description: This Java source file defines the class SubscriptionHasNextPage, which represents an event signaling that a page of search results is available in a subscription context. The class provides methods to construct instances from parameters or JSON, retrieve the items (search results), and create modified copies with different headers or items. It also overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString, and includes nested classes defining JSON field names.

classes.name: SubscriptionHasNextPage
classes.description: Immutable class representing a 'next page' event in a subscription search context, holding a JSON array of items and methods for construction, JSON deserialization, and modification.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionHasNextPage with specified subscription ID, items, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionHasNextPage object from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the JSON array of search result items in this page.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Returns a new SubscriptionHasNextPage instance with a different set of items.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer, indicating the resource path.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of this event with a new set of headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the items JSON array to a JSON object builder.
